ctx.x:
Oh.

What playing had you done in New Orleans?

Oh, I played with several bands. In fact, when I first started out we had a couple of fellows (instruments) that was learning -- one, by the name of Landry, was trying to play trumpet, and we had another guy trying to play drums. And it was all youngsters and we were all learning together at the

same time. We had about three tunes we could play, and one of them I'll never forget was 'The Sheik.' And so we used to go around [ ] for a Saturday and some of the people would have a party, a yard party, and we gave our services for nothing. We'd make them charge admission at the gate to come in and we'd take the proceeds and we'd wind up with a quarter apiece for the night's work. But we played those three pieces to death, every night.
